schema.title: EntryRecordView
schema.description: One posted entry, as the app's `EntryRecord` types it.

external_id.description: The source application's idempotency key, if it gave one.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year its number is scoped to.

number.description: The gapless number within the journal and fiscal year.

posted_by.description: Who posted it: `agent` (an agent key) or `person`.

reverses.description: The entry this one reverses, when it is a reversal.

reversed_by.description: The entry that reverses this one, if any.

schema.title: EntriesPostInput
schema.description:
The input of `entries.post`: a balanced entry and, optionally, the
journal and fiscal year to post it to (defaults: journal `GN`, and the
fiscal year of the posting date).

journal_id.description: The journal to post into; defaults to the general journal `GN`.

fiscal_year.description:
The fiscal year the entry number is scoped to; defaults to the
posting date's year.

entry.description: The entry: header, dates and lines.
The posted entry with its assigned number.

schema.title: EntriesReverseInput
schema.description:
The input of `entries.reverse`: the external id of the entry to reverse
(from the path) and the posting date of the reversal (default: today).

external_id.description: The `external_id` the reversed entry was posted with.

posting_date.description: The reversal's posting date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; defaults to today (UTC).

entry.description: The posted entry with its assigned number.

name.description: A label for the key, shown in the app and the audit trail.

limits.description:
Per-currency limits, keyed by ISO 4217 code. A currency with no entry
is not allowed at all (fail closed).

schema.title: KeysCreateOutput
schema.description: Output of `keys.create`: the key, and its full token, shown once.

token.description: The full bearer token. It is not stored and cannot be shown again.

keys.description: Every agent key of the company, revoked ones included.

schema.title: KeysRevokeInput
schema.description: Input of `keys.revoke`: the key's `id`, as `keys.list` returns it.

AccountView.description: One account of the chart, as the app's `Account` types it, plus its balances.

account_type.description: The account class: asset, liability, equity, income, expense.

currency.description: The account currency, or `null` for the company base currency.

parent.description: The parent account number, if any.

tags.description: The chart tags of the account.

is_postable.description: Whether the account accepts postings (a leaf of the chart).

balances.description: The balance per base currency, debit-positive (empty when no postings).

minor.description: The minor units as a string.

EntryLineRecordView.description: One entry line, as the app's `EntryLineRecord` types it.

base.description: The base amount, in minor units of the entry's base currency.

EntryRecordView.description: One posted entry, as the app's `EntryRecord` types it.

external_id.description: The source application's idempotency key, if it gave one.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year its number is scoped to.

number.description: The gapless number within the journal and fiscal year.

posted_by.description: Who posted it: `agent` (an agent key) or `person`.

reverses.description: The entry this one reverses, when it is a reversal.

reversed_by.description: The entry that reverses this one, if any.

external_id.description: External ID from the source application (for idempotency).

source_app.description: The application that posted this entry.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year the number is scoped to.

LimitAmounts.description:
One currency's limits, as canonical decimal strings in major units
(`"1000.00"` for EUR is 100000 minor units).

per_entry.description: The most one entry may move in this currency.

per_day.description: The most the key may move in this currency in a rolling day.

AgentKeyView.description: One agent key as the owner sees it. Never carries the secret.

name.description: The label the key was created with.

prefix.description: The public prefix, `lk_live_<id>`. The secret part is never shown again.

limits.description: Per-currency limits, in canonical major-unit strings.

created_by.description: The person who created the key.

last_used_at.description: When the key last authenticated a request, at most one write per minute.

revoked_at.description: When the key was revoked, if it was.

debit.description: The debit total of the period.

credit.description: The credit total of the period.
